shortDescription: Practical maritime calculators with local inputs, exports and offline tools.
fullDescription:
Marine Tools brings practical maritime calculations to your phone, tablet or computer.

Use local tools for vessel allowances, anchoring geometry, air-draft clearance, fuel and energy conversions, electrical power and engineering estimates. Enter your own values and units, review assumptions, and recalculate before using a result.

Keep vessel profiles and recent calculations locally. Reopen supported calculator inputs, copy results, and export or share files using the options available on your device. Core bundled calculators work without an internet connection.

This candidate does not provide live AIS or weather. The separate Education workspace requires online, protected access and is not included in the offline package. No account is needed for the bundled local calculators.

Marine Tools is a planning and calculation aid. It is not approved navigation equipment, a certified safety system, an official record book or a replacement for vessel-specific documentation and professional judgement. Verify inputs, assumptions and results before operational use.

appleAppStore.reviewNotes: This is a local calculator application, not a remote website shell. Calculations, local profiles and recent work function without an account or network. Review a vessel air-clearance example: open Vessel Calculations, enter published clearance 25 m, water level 0.8 m, air draft 20 m and margin 1 m; Calculate returns 3.20 m. Native integrations provide clipboard and the system share sheet for text/files. Education is a separate protected online preview and is not bundled; it is not needed to review local functionality. Live AIS/weather and analytics are disabled. No login credentials are needed for local tools. This submission draft must not be used before device/export tests and owner approvals are completed.
